more_info.overview: Sodium formate is the sodium salt of formic acid. It is generally supplied as a white crystalline material and can act as a buffer in chemical formulations. This entry records its historical food-additive designation. The reviewed description does not identify a typical current human-food example. Industrial uses of the same chemical do not establish a food-grade preparation or food-use conditions.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
